waking.oneShot: stretch: scaleX #cat 1..1.06 0.8s, then transition to begging

begging.loop: bounce #cat translateY 0..-8px 0.6s; wave #paw-left/#paw-right alternate; pop #hunger-bubble every 20s

petted.loop: float #hearts children translateY -20px + fade 1.4s staggered; wiggle #tail

playing.loop: pounce #cat translateX 0..14px + bob 0.5s; roll #yarn rotate 360deg 1.2s; wiggle #yarn-tail; flash #motion-lines

celebrating.oneShot: jump #cat translateY -24px 0.5s bounce x2; spin #coin rotateY; twinkle #sparkles

livingroom.dayNight: swap #window-sky fill #BEE3F2 (day) / #1E2A4A (night); #sun opacity 1/0; #stars opacity 0/1; raise #lamp-glow at night

garden.ambient: drift #clouds translateX 60s loop; sway .flower rotate -3..3deg 2.5s; flutter #butterfly along bezier

jungle.ambient: pulse #fireflies opacity 0.3..1 staggered (night only); sway #big-leaves rotate 2deg 4s

treehouse.ambient: fly #bird translateX -500px 25s loop; sway #hanging-leaves rotate 3deg 3.5s; flicker #lantern glow at night
